html:
Planning a corn on the cob skewer party? The secret to a smooth, crowd‑pleasing spread is having the right tools at hand. With a few clever gadgets you can keep the corn hot, the skewers organized, and the drinks festive—all without breaking a sweat.

Grab and Grill: Tools for Perfect Corn on the Cob

The star of the show is, of course, the corn itself. The Interlocking Corn on the Cob Holders (5 Pairs) are a game‑changer. Their bright silicone handles keep each ear secure while the interlocking design saves drawer space. Slip the corn onto the stainless‑steel skewers, grill for 10‑12 minutes, and you’ll have evenly cooked, buttery kernels ready to serve.

For a hands‑free option, the Vertical Gyro Pan with Skewer for Oven lets you roast multiple ears at once. The vertical design promotes even heat circulation, and the built‑in skewer keeps the corn upright for easy turning.

Dress the Drip: Cocktail Umbrellas, Straws, and Picks

No summer party is complete without a splash of color in the drinks. The 150-Pack Cocktail Drink Umbrellas & Picks add a tropical vibe to margaritas, sangria, or even a simple iced tea. Pair them with the 100-Pack Umbrella Straws for a playful, Instagram‑ready presentation that keeps guests reaching for more.

If you’re serving mini appetizers on the side—think cheese balls or shrimp cocktail—those same umbrella picks double as tiny cocktail picks, keeping each bite tidy and decorative.

Skewer Savvy: Keeping Your Party Organized

When you’re threading corn, veggies, or meat onto skewers, you need a reliable way to store and serve them. The interlocking corn holders double as skewer racks for other foods, but you can also add a Taco Holder Stand for upright taco or kebab displays. This keeps the presentation neat and prevents soggy bottoms.

For extra fun, try the Extendable Prank Fork (2‑Pack). While primarily a gag gift, its telescoping action can be used to pull a stray skewer out of the grill without burning your fingers.

Prep Like a Pro: Cutting, Mixing, and Seasoning

Before the corn hits the grill, you’ll want to prep butter, herbs, and spices. A Herb Scissors makes quick work of cilantro or parsley, and the Spice & Pepper Grinder lets you grind fresh pepper directly onto the corn for a burst of flavor.

For those who love a homemade garlic butter, the Garlic Press crushes cloves in seconds, and the Wooden Spurtle & Sourdough Starter Stirrer Set is perfect for mixing melted butter with herbs without splattering.

If you’re adding veggie kebabs to the mix, a Mandoline Slicer ensures uniform slices of zucchini or bell pepper, which cook evenly alongside the corn.

Finishing Touches: Serving, Cooling, and Clean‑up

Once the corn is grilled and the drinks are ready, presentation matters. Place each cob in a holder, add a dab of butter, and sprinkle with fresh herbs. Serve the drinks in glasses topped with the umbrella straws for that festive feel.

Cleanup is a breeze with Silicone Baking Mats on your grill surface—catch any butter drips and discard the mat when you’re done. For leftover butter or sauce, the Jar & Bottle Opener makes opening stubborn lids quick and easy.

Finally, keep the party going with a quick cocktail shake using the Cocktail Shaker Set. A few shakes, a splash of lime, and you’ve got a refreshing drink to pair with the sweet, smoky corn.

FAQ

Do I need a special grill for the corn on the cob holders?

No. The Interlocking Corn on the Cob Holders work on any standard grill or stovetop grill pan. Just make sure the skewers are placed over direct heat.

Can the umbrella straws be used for hot drinks?

They are designed for cold beverages, but they can handle warm drinks like iced tea or lemonade. Avoid boiling liquids, as the paper parasol may become soggy.

What’s the best way to store leftover corn holders?

Because they interlock, you can keep them together in a drawer or on a shelf. They are dishwasher‑safe, so a quick rinse after the party will keep them ready for the next event.
